judged_text: Gating inconsistency: APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED only requires the webhook secret and encryption key while refreshOAuthTokens also requires CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, so self-hosters with secret/key but no endpoint get the minimum token schema plus placeholder refresh_token behavior with the real refresh flow, corrupting stored credentials

adjudication.rationale: The claimed bad combination (APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED true but no CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT) does not trigger the minimum-token-schema/placeholder-refresh_token path. In parseRefreshTokenResponse, the minimum schema is only used when BOTH APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT are truthy; otherwise it falls back to the provided schema. Likewise, refreshOAuthTokens only switches to the external endpoint when both APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT (and userId) are truthy; otherwise it calls the normal refreshFunction. So a self-hoster with secret+key but no endpoint will use the normal refresh flow and normal schema validation, not the minimum schema + placeholder refresh_token behavior described.
